question: Should this Nostr sanitizer PR wait for live relay or non-mocked runtime proof, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate for this sanitizer-boundary fix?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and the patch is narrow, but external PRs need real behavior proof unless maintainers intentionally accept focused sanitizer-boundary evidence.

options.title: Wait For Real Nostr Proof
options.body: Require redacted live relay logs, runtime output, or an equivalent non-mocked Nostr run before merge.

options.title: Accept Maintainer Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer may clear the proof gate if they validate the Nostr runtime path separately or decide the focused sanitizer evidence is enough for this branch.
